entities.summary: Anyda Nelson Yarborough De Armond Marchant was a Brazilian-born American lawyer, one of the first women to pass the Bar in Washington D.C., and a founding partner of Naiad Press and A&M Books. She was also an author of primarily lesbian fiction, for which she wrote under the pseudonym Sarah Aldridge.
